title: kit.legacy-migration-comments.v1
description: The kit-shipped migrations applied before the comment rule of 2026-10-14 (kit check migrations: no semicolon and no apostrophe inside a -- comment, because remote D1 splits a migration at a semicolon and chokes on quotes). An applied migration is never edited, so its exact bytes (sha256) are excused. The list only shrinks.

base.description: The ref the shrink-only proof compares against (the branch the kit's pull requests merge into)
